title: Caramelised Leek Pasta
subtitle: with Pumpkin and Feta
description: Bring out the natural sweetness in leek by pan-frying with pumpkin and garlic until soft and caramelised. Toss with pasta, baby spinach, feta and walnuts, and enjoy dead-set delicious flavours.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Meanwhile, discard the dark green part of the leek (see cooking tip). Cut 1 leek in half lengthwise and add to the pasta cooking water. Thinly slice the remaining leek and set aside. Slice 2 garlic cloves. Peel the pumpkin and cut into 1-2cm chunks.
Toast walnuts: Put the walnuts in a cold large frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan and set aside. Reserve the pan.

Cook pasta: Cook three-quarters of the pasta (the remaining pasta won't be used in this dish) in the pan of boiling water for 6-8 mins until al dente. Reserve 60ml (¼ cup) cooking water, then drain the pasta and leek.

Cook vegetables: While the pasta is cooking, coarsely chop the walnuts. Heat 2 tbs olive oil in the reserved frypan over medium heat. Cook the pumpkin, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins. Add the garlic and sliced leek and cook, stirring, for 5 mins or until softened and light golden. Season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Add the spinach and cook, tossing, for 1-2 mins until the spinach is starting to wilt. Add the pasta and leek mixture and reserved cooking water, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Divide the caramelised leek pasta among bowls. Scatter over the walnuts and crumble over half the feta (the remaining feta won't be used in this dish) to serve.
Make it yours: Add a little kick with a smattering of finely chopped red chilli or scatter over chopped dill or parsley for fresh, fragrant herbs.
